newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CSM seals Droste sale to Hosta.
newsitem.headline: CSM seals Droste sale to Hosta.

text.p: Dutch food group CSM NV said on Wednesday it had finalised the sale of its chocolate maker Droste to Hosta Werk fuer Schokolade Spezialitaeten of Germany for an undisclosed sum.
"The takeover will become effective on January 1, 1997," CSM said in a statement.
Droste, a chocolate products maker in the southern Dutch town of Vaassen, turns over some 30 million guilders a year.
CSM said Hosta would continue Droste's existing production activities in Vaassen and add new ones.
It said its Vaassen-based chocolate vermicelli production, part of CSM's De Ruijter subsidiary, would be moved to De Ruijter's Baarn plant in 1997.
